title: CWP/18701/2025 of JAGTAR SINGH AND OTHERS Vs THE STATE OF PUNJAB AND  OTHERS
respondents: The State Of Punjab And  Others
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Sr. No.118 CWP-18701-2025 Date of decision : 06.08.2025 Jagtar Singh andothers eee Petitioners Versus The Stateof Punjab and others Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK SIBAL HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE LAPITA BANERJI Present : Mr. Surinder Sharma, Advocate, for the petitioners. Mr. Shekhar Verma, Addl. A.G., Punjab. Ms. Kavita Arora, Advocate, for respondents No.2 and 3. 2K OK OK OK OK DEEPAK SIBAL, J. (Oral)

1. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that at this stage, he would be satisfied if the present writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the Chairman, Jalandhar Improvement Trust, Jalandhar-respondent No.2 to take a decision on the representation dated 07.11.2017 (Annexure P-3), submitted by the petitioners.

2. Learned State counsel and learned counsel for respondents No.2 & 3, who appear on advance notice, have no objection if the above prayer is accepted.

3. Accordingly, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 to take a decision on the representation dated 07.11.2017 (Annexure P-3), submitted by the petitioners, by passing a speaking order and after affording opportunity of hearing to all concerned, preferably within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

4. Needless to add that the decision so taken be communicated to the petitioners and if the decision is not to the satisfaction of the petitioners, they would be at liberty to challenge the same, in accordance with law. [DEEPAK SIBAL] JUDGE 06.08.2025 [LAPITA BANERJI] Jyoti Thakur JUDGE
